evaluationCost.note: evaluation cost; never added to arm cost

evidence.quote: let private booksAreNew (books: Receivables) = books.Books.Customers.IsEmpty && ... && books.Payments.IsEmpty

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The new domain rules are the file format, the version check, the book checks, the data-version match and the 'only into new books' rule. They live in Summa.Storage (Tier 2) and Summa.Web.Engine (Tier 2). Tier 3 only maps three kernel event names to engine messages and decides nothing.

evidence.quote: match Transfer.export manifest books ctx.Now with ... model, [ OfferDownload(name, "application/json", Convert.ToBase64String(...)) ]

ARC-REV-02.rationale: Transfer is pure and takes the export time as a parameter. The engine gets the time from ctx.Now. The download is requested as an OfferDownload effect, as data, and the saving as a SaveBooks effect. No clock, I/O or other effect is added below Tier 4.

evidence.quote: { model with Error = Some "This browser cannot offer downloads here." }

ARC-REV-03.rationale: Each new fact has one definition: Schema, Version, stampFormat, the GitHub-moved sentence (booksOnGitHubMoved) and booksAreNew. Only a pre-existing user-facing sentence is repeated, and it agrees with the original. The 'yyyy-MM-dd' format is used in two display contexts, which is trivial.

evidence.quote: if version = 2m && claimed <> Some actualContents then Error "The books in this file do not match its contents."

ARC-REV-01.rationale: The count definition, the content-match rule, the version acceptance and the preview wording are all in Tier 2 (Storage and Engine). Tier 3 changes nothing except that the HTML shows the view value. No domain rule is decided in Tier 3 or 4.

ARC-REV-02.rationale: The preview is a pure projection from the model text through the pure Transfer.read. No clock, I/O or other effect is added anywhere below Tier 4.

evidence.quote: if version = 2m && claimed <> Some actualContents then
| Error why -> $"This file cannot be imported: {why}"
| Error why -> { model with Error = Some $"This file cannot be imported: {why}" }, []

ARC-REV-03.rationale: The counts have one definition, contentsOf, which export, read and the preview all use. Three things are restated, and the copies agree. First, the literal 2m in read duplicates the new-version number that Version = 2 already holds. Second, the 'This file cannot be imported: ' prefix is written both in the preview and in BooksTransferImported. Third, the date format string is repeated. Changing any one of these could drift from the others.
